summary: Comprehensive testing of Gatewise v0.3.0-alpha with advanced features (JIT Access, Drift Detection, WebSocket). 35/36 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI fully functional with all pages and workflows working. ALL APIS ARE MOCKED in Python server.py - no real backend Go integration yet.

minor.issue: WebSocket connection test times out in pytest environment using websocket-client library
minor.note: WebSocket works in browser (as seen in console logs), likely library/SSL handshake issue in test

issues: Drift cards layout lacks proper card styling - showing as flat list format instead of card grid
WebSocket status shows 'Offline' even when browser WebSocket is connected (Live indicator in sidebar)

passed_tests: Backend API Tests (35/36):
- Health endpoint (/api/health)
- Status endpoint (/api/status) with version, license, features, connectors
- Policies CRUD (GET list, GET single, POST create, PUT update, DELETE, POST reconcile)
- Policy validation (/api/policies/validate) with valid/invalid YAML, apiVersion, kind, name
- JIT Access (GET /api/jit, POST /api/jit/request with enterprise license)
- JIT license enforcement (403 without enterprise)
- Drift Detection (GET /api/drift, POST /api/drift/simulate, POST /api/drift/{id}/repair, POST /api/drift/repair-all)
- Drift license enforcement (403 without enterprise)
- Connectors (GET /api/connectors, K8s available, Kafka/Kong locked in community)
- License (GET /api/license, POST /api/license with ENT- prefix)
- Audit logs (GET /api/audit, log creation on policy events)
- CLI (gatewise-cli --version returns 0.3.0-alpha)
Frontend UI Tests:
- Dashboard loading with stats cards (Policies, JIT Active, Drifts, License)
- Navigation to all pages (Dashboard, Policies, Connectors, JIT, Drift, Audit, Settings)
- Create Policy modal with YAML editor
- JIT Request modal with form fields
- Settings page license management (community to enterprise upgrade)
- License tier badge updates correctly
- Connectors show Available/Locked based on license
- Real-time stats update after JIT grants and drift events
critical_code_review_comments: MOCKED APIS: All backend APIs are mocked in Python server.py with in-memory data stores (policies_db, jit_grants, drift_events). Real Go backend (gatewise-server) is not integrated yet.
Data persistence: All data is lost on server restart since it's stored in memory dictionaries.
WebSocket: Frontend shows 'Offline' in sidebar even when WS is connected - may need to check wsConnected state propagation.
test_credentials: Enterprise License Key: ENT-TEST-KEY (any key starting with ENT- enables enterprise)
seed_data_creation: Created test policies with TEST_ prefix during testing, auto-cleaned via fixtures
context_for_next_testing_agent: All advanced features working in MOCKED mode. JIT Access and Drift Detection require Enterprise license (set via Settings or API). WebSocket broadcasts real-time updates to connected clients. CLI binary at /app/gatewise/bin/gatewise-cli works (--version tested). Backend Go server compiled but not yet integrated with Python proxy.
mocked_api_warning: ALL APIs ARE MOCKED - The Python server.py implements all endpoints with in-memory data storage. The real Go backend (gatewise-server binary) is compiled but NOT connected to the Python proxy. This is a complete MOCKED implementation for UI/UX validation.
